First common release of the five `mobilityid` implementations: Scala, Java, Go, PHP and
TypeScript are published from this one commit and share the version number. All ports parse,
validate, render and convert EV contract ids (ISO 15118, EMI3, DIN SPEC 91286) and EVSE ids
(ISO and DIN) with the same fixtures, the same check-digit algorithms and the same ISO 3166-1
country list.

## Install

| Implementation | Registry | Snippet |
|---|---|---|
| Scala 2.13 / 3.9 LTS | Maven Central | `libraryDependencies += "dev.juherr.mobilityid" %% "mobilityid" % "0.2.0"` (+ `"mobilityid-interpolators"` for the compile-time interpolators) |
| Java 21+ | Maven Central | `implementation("dev.juherr.mobilityid:mobilityid4j:0.2.0")` |
| Go 1.26+ | proxy.golang.org | `go get mobilityid.juherr.dev/go/mobilityid@v0.2.0` |
| PHP 8.4+ | Packagist | `composer require juherr/mobility-id:^0.2` |
| TypeScript / Node 22+ | npm (with provenance) | `npm install @juherr/mobilityid@0.2.0` |

## Highlights

- **Scala:** artifacts move to `dev.juherr.mobilityid` (Scala 2.13.18 and 3.9 LTS, JDK 17
  bytecode); the package stays `com.thenewmotion.mobilityid`. Scalafmt, Scalafix, fatal warnings
  and MiMa now guard the library.
- **Java (`mobilityid4j`):** JSpecify-annotated, `@NullMarked` JPMS module; tolerant `parse*`
  methods return `@Nullable T`; property-based and consumer smoke tests.
- **Go:** typed sentinel errors usable with `errors.Is`, `encoding.TextMarshaler` /
  `TextUnmarshaler` on every identifier, no third-party dependency, `Example*` and `Fuzz*`
  targets. `go get ...@latest` is repaired (see Go migration below).
- **PHP:** `final readonly` value objects, PHP 8.4+, cross-language check-digit fixtures, a full
  quality gate (php-cs-fixer, PHPStan level 10, Rector, Infection 100 % MSI).
- **TypeScript:** ESM-only package, `tryParse` returning a `ParseResult`, `ValidationError`,
  `CountryCode` as a literal union of the 249 ISO 3166-1 codes, branded identifier strings.
- **All ports:** `CountryCode` rejects the CLDR region codes ISO 3166-1 does not assign (`EU`,
  `UK`, `XK`, ...); a leading `E` in an EVSE power outlet id is kept; the DIN check digit no
  longer overflows on long payloads.

## Migration notes

- **Scala:** replace `com.thenewmotion` coordinates with `dev.juherr.mobilityid`; Scala 2.12 and
  3.3 builds are gone (Scala 3 needs a 3.9+ compiler).
- **Java:** wrap `parse*` results with `Optional.ofNullable(...)` where an `Optional` was used.
- **Go:** Go 1.26 is the minimum. JSON encoding of an identifier now yields its canonical string
  (`"NL-TNM-000122045-U"`) instead of `{}`; error messages start with the sentinel text. `v0.1.0`
  is retracted (permissive country codes, DIN check-digit overflow), and so are `v1.0.0`-`v1.1.1`,
  which never contained Go code: `go list -m -u` warns on any of them, `@latest` selects `v0.2.0`.
- **PHP:** PHP 8.4+; value-object properties are read-only.
- **TypeScript:** `ProviderId`, `PhoneCountryCode`, `OperatorIdIso`, `OperatorIdDin` and
  `CountryCode` are typed strings: replace `id.value` with `id`, drop `instanceof` checks.
  `CountryCode` literals must be uppercase at the type level (`CountryCode.from("nl")` still
  normalizes). The package is ESM-only.

The full, grouped record is in `CHANGELOG.md`.
